name: Quell The Uprising
summary: Warden Thelwater calls for help as the Stockade erupts in riot beneath Stormwind. Defias prisoners have seized the cell blocks, and he wants the uprising crushed before the city's leaders learn how badly the prison has failed.

sections.title: A Prison Lost to Its Inmates
sections.body: The Stockade holds criminals, conspirators, and outlaws who threaten the Kingdom of Stormwind. Imprisoned Defias operatives have launched a sudden, violent uprising and taken the cell blocks from the guards. Armed felons crowd the corridors, and the usual order has broken down. The guards now depend on visiting champions to fight through the riot and retake the prison.

sections.title: Desperation and Cover-Up
sections.body: Warden Thelwater orders Defias prisoners killed on sight out of desperation and fear for his position. He suspects foul play behind the coordinated mutiny. If the House of Nobles or the wider nobility learns the Stockade is out of control, he fears he will lose his post. Thelwater hopes a death sentence for insurgency will break the inmates' resolve and crush the rebellion before word passes the canal gates.

faq.q: Why is Warden Thelwater asking adventurers to put down the riot?
faq.answer: The guards have lost control of the Stockade's interior cells to rioting Defias inmates. Warden Thelwater fears losing his position if Stormwind's leaders learn the full scale of the disaster, so he hires capable mercenaries to kill the ringleaders and restore control quickly.

faq.q: Who are the inmates rioting in the Stockade?
faq.answer: Captured Defias Brotherhood members form the heart of the uprising. They include common prisoners, hardened convicts, and organized insurgents, locked away while the brotherhood waged its secret war across Westfall and Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Does Thelwater believe the riot was an inside job?
faq.answer: Yes. Warden Thelwater suspects foul play and believes a revolt this sudden and complete could not happen by chance, without outside interference or compromised security within the city.

faq.q: Where does this uprising take place?
faq.answer: The uprising takes place inside The Stockade, a subterranean maximum-security dungeon along the canals in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: What happens after these Defias rioters are killed?
faq.answer: Killing the rioters weakens the mutineers, but Warden Thelwater admits when you return that the crisis runs deeper than a simple scuffle. Further strikes against high-profile leaders deeper in the cells are needed.

faq.q: Is lethal force authorized against all escaped convicts?
faq.answer: Warden Thelwater declares immediate death the penalty for active insurgency during the takeover. He orders champions to execute prisoners, convicts, and insurgents on the spot, hoping to force the survivors into submission.

angles.text: The Stockade rebellion rages beneath Stormwind's streets, a grave security failure at the heart of the Alliance's primary kingdom.
Many Defias inmates in the cells are former kingdom stonemasons and common folk driven to rebel. Their bloody riot is a painful civil conflict for Stormwind's people.
As a paladin, restoring order beneath the city tests the line between righteous justice and desperate, lethal retribution against rebellious citizens.
